card.name: Word just before a dose number
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces right before a dose amount or interval number, such as 'above', 'every', 'to' or 'at least'. It appears in dosing instructions and dose-adjustment tables.

modes.label: Interval lead-in
modes.description: The gap or word after 'every' just before an hour count.

modes.label: Threshold word
modes.description: 'Above' or 'to' introducing a limit or new dose value.
